payload.body: ST0003/WP03 (shared mode on one live login), 350e689: PASS on vc's read, with your run in slot 01M7A10VT8E47A13AR5BYK4RK6 and its eleven mutant reds as the one run. Read against AC-03.1 to AC-03.4: switch::to finishes a pending move first (verifying again at Begun), checks the login and the account record before anything moves, adopts 0.1.8's layout only through adoption's pure rule, relocates with one retry on Unverified, then records, activates and clears launchd with its output captured; seat::home refuses both profiles of an unfinished move; usage and list read through home; run removes CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR from the child; dir fails for the seated profile; login reseats and logout refuses the active one; standing makes a login dead only on Refused, after a renewal is written back. Go: land it, re-cite AT-02.1 to AT-02.9, mint AT-03.1 to AT-03.10 and AT-02.10, get intent at lint ST0003 clean, and tell vc; vc closes WP03. Notes, none blocking: (1) Refused is any 400 or 401 from the token endpoint, and adoption now acts on it; a malformed request or a changed client also gets a 400, so before the cut, take a 400 as refused only when its error is invalid_grant. (2) parked_accounts counts a profile's configured email as a login of that account; prefer the record the profile's .claude.json keeps, which Claude Code wrote at login, and fall back to the configured email only when there is none. (3) use --none says no account is active, while the active record and dir still name the profile, as AT-03.4 shows; say that no login is in the shared config instead. It also clears launchd's variable, where 0.1.8 points it at the active profile, so Claude started from a GUI app has no login until the older ccusage's use NAME; say so, or set it. (4) Adoption's network path is unit-tested only, so WP06's rollout is its end-to-end proof: vc's steps read its message and doctor's lines after the first use. (5) For WP06, no change here: a session pinned to a profile through CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR keeps reading that profile's own store, which the seat clears, so the rollout quits every Claude session before the first use and starts shells afresh after it. vc writes that.
